Definition: akin to the base of G2753; to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise):--bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-)name (was (called)).
BiblicalUsage: Kaleo is to call — to summon aloud, to name, to invite. God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of His Son; He has called us out of darkness into His marvellous light; and John marvels that we should be called the sons of God — and that is what we are.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe calling is the beginning of everything. God calls, and the called answer; He names us His sons, and the name is not a title but a fact — and that is why I hold that no one who is called is ever called by accident.
